value: Weak but brave, it's a great alternative to saving money!
Archers offer affordable and persistent firepower during 3 turns!
Knight charges into battle with strength and valor, worth every gold coin!
Hurls massive harpoons only at enemy bastions, dealing damage over 3 turns!
Hurls boulders that ignore the bastion, smashing directly into the enemy castle for colossal damage!
Cyclops, a towering golem, brings down castles with terrifying strength.
Digs up a hefty amount of gold.
Generates a modest amount of gold during 3 turns.
Trades castle height for hefty amounts of gold.
Sells a section of the bastion for gold.
Sell 1 diamond for a hefty amount of gold.
Raises additional castle height.
The Bastion raises its height, bolstering castle defenses.
Grants you the choice to upgrade either the bastion or the castle.
Deep Mining strikes diamond, adding a precious gem to your resources!
Purchase a diamond for a modest amount of gold, a valuable opportunity!
The Sovereign will sell a large piece of the castle for some diamonds. The villagers wonder why.
The Bard boosts the amount of gold gained from the next gold-generating card.
Create chaos in enemy kingdom, stealing 1 diamond if available, along with gold, wall height, castle height, and inflicts damage, all transferred to you.
Allows you to store a card for use in any other turn, but storing a new card replaces the previous one.
Boosts the damage of the next attacking card you use.
By opening this mysterious portal, you gain the power to play twice, but at a valuable cost.
Impenetrable as diamond, Adamant absorbs the next attack card.
Like a whisper in the darkness, the Rogue transfers life and height from the enemy castle for you castle.
Your castle and bastion tear through the skies, growing immensely for a large sum of diamonds.
Completely demolishes the enemy bastion for a high cost in diamonds.
Emerging from ancient ruins, the Dragon returns to annihilate the enemy's hopes, dealing immense damage and ruining everything they have tried to build up until now.
Upon skipping the turn, the queen of thieves steals 1 gold from the opponent to him.
Upon skipping the turn, the Spectral Queen casts a Fireball that deals 8 damage only to the opponent's bastion.
Upon skipping the turn, the Barbarian King hurls an axe that deals 4 damage.
Upon skipping the turn, Leaf king creates a ent that creates +5 bastion.
Upon skipping the turn, the Mining Queen utilizes less valuable miners and generates 2 gold.
Upon skipping the turn, the Alien Generator accumulates a diamond fragment. Upon collecting 4, it gains a full diamond.
